architecturalChoice.implementedBoundary: One configuration scope per FormView/Application, with explicit provider and child-Application ownership. This is a host counterpart to provider roles, not a Vue/React component object.
architecturalChoice.notImplemented: No literal $cmp:FormKitLazyProvider or $cmp:FormKitProvider nested in an already-owned single form. This is explicitly still outside literal schema-component API parity.
whyCurrentABIRequiresBroaderChange: schema-layout.mjs projects/allocates $formkit descendants before ordinary $cmp factories

renderChildren currently passes lexical/node scope, not a FormKit option-provider boundary
smallestCoordinatorOptions: Adopt this actual Application-level mapping and use registered child Applications for separately scoped FormViews. No renderer/projector ABI change required.

If same-form nested provider components are required, add an opaque provider projection boundary, carry option scopes through renderChildren/factory args, and teach Core creation/cleanup to use the inherited scoped definitions/plugins/config. Coordinate that separate shared-ABI change with the sole writer.
architecturalChoice.restartContract: Retains current View during loading/failure; successful restart replaces its form View. Registered children retain their scopes until explicitly restarted, following Marionette Application semantics.
